warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE D165 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ200D (Ingenium) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200D (Ingenium) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D (Ingenium) rebuild.
Because the XE D165 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XE 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ200D (Ingenium) specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
